es: Reescribir una misma petición para tres lectores (compañero, profesor, gerente) con registro, suavizado y conectores adecuados a cada uno.

teaching.en: Hey Sam, could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family thing.
teaching.es: Oye, Sam, ¿podemos cambiar el jueves por el viernes? Tengo un asunto familiar.
teaching.explanationEs: Con un compañero basta una pregunta breve con could we.
segments: Hey Sam, could we swap Thursday for
Friday? I have a family thing.
teaching.audioText: Hey Sam, could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family thing.

teaching.en: Would it be possible to move my session to Friday? Friday would be more convenient.
teaching.es: ¿Sería posible pasar mi sesión al viernes? El viernes me resultaría más cómodo.
teaching.explanationEs: Would it be possible + razón: neutro y respetuoso, para un profesor.
segments: Would it be possible to move my session
to Friday? Friday would be more convenient.
teaching.audioText: Would it be possible to move my session to Friday? Friday would be more convenient.

teaching.en: I was wondering whether you could move my booking; it would be really helpful.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podría cambiar mi reserva; me ayudaría mucho.
teaching.explanationEs: I was wondering whether + could suaviza mucho la petición.
segments: I was wondering whether you could move
my booking; it would be really helpful.
teaching.audioText: I was wondering whether you could move my booking; it would be really helpful.

teaching.en: It is essential that I change my booking, because I will be away on Thursday.
teaching.es: Es imprescindible que cambie mi reserva, porque estaré fuera el jueves.
teaching.explanationEs: Cuando hay urgencia real, essential refuerza la petición.
segments: It is essential that I change my booking,
because I will be away on Thursday.
teaching.audioText: It is essential that I change my booking, because I will be away on Thursday.

teaching.en: The studio is closed on Thursday; therefore, I would like to move my booking.
teaching.es: El estudio cierra el jueves; por lo tanto, quisiera cambiar mi reserva.
teaching.explanationEs: Therefore es un conector formal de consecuencia.
segments: The studio is closed on Thursday; therefore,
I would like to move my booking.
teaching.audioText: The studio is closed on Thursday; therefore, I would like to move my booking.

teaching.en: I apologise for the short notice. Moreover, I can come at any time on Friday.
teaching.es: Pido disculpas por el poco aviso. Además, puedo ir a cualquier hora el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Moreover añade un dato a favor; apologise suaviza en un mensaje formal.
segments: I apologise for the short notice. Moreover, I
can come at any time on Friday.
teaching.audioText: I apologise for the short notice. Moreover, I can come at any time on Friday.

prompt.es: Elige el saludo que encaja con una petición a un profesor.

feedback.es: Conoces su apellido y debes mostrar respeto: Dear + Mr + apellido; Hey es demasiado informal.

hint.es: Conoces su nombre y debes mostrar respeto.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Sería posible cambiar mi sesión al viernes?»

feedback.es: Would it be possible to + verbo es la forma neutra y educada de pedir un cambio.

hint.es: Es un adjetivo: lo contrario de imposible.

origin.text: Would it be ___ to move my session to Friday?

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Podemos intercambiar mi turno por el tuyo?»

answer.text: Could we swap my shift for yours

feedback.es: Swap A for B significa cambiar A por B, y could we suaviza la petición entre compañeros.

prompt.es: Elige la versión que refuerza la petición porque hay urgencia real.

choices.text: I was wondering whether you might possibly move my booking.
Perhaps you could move my booking, if it is not too much trouble.
It is essential that I move my booking, because I will be away.

feedback.es: Essential marca que el cambio es imprescindible; las otras dos suavizan la petición.

prompt.es: Elige la versión que suaviza más la petición.

choices.text: I was wondering whether you could move my booking.
I must move my booking to Friday.

feedback.es: I was wondering whether + could convierte la petición en una pregunta indirecta muy cortés.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada conector o verbo con su significado.

feedback.es: Therefore marca consecuencia, moreover suma un dato, however contrasta y apologise suaviza una molestia.

prompt.es: Escribe las tres versiones de la petición: para Sam, para Mr Lee y para el gerente.

answer.text: To Sam: Hey Sam, could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family event, so Friday would be easier. Cheers! To Mr Lee: Dear Mr Lee, would it be possible to move my session to Friday? I will be away on Thursday because of a family event. Thank you for your time. To the manager: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding my booking for Thursday. I would be grateful if you could move it to Friday, as I have a family event. Kind regards.
accepted: To Sam: Hey Sam, could we swap Thursday for Friday? I have a family event, so Friday would be easier. Cheers! To Mr Lee: Dear Mr Lee, would it be possible to move my session to Friday? I will be away on Thursday because of a family event. Thank you for your time. To the manager: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding my booking for Thursday. I would be grateful if you could move it to Friday, as I have a family event. Kind regards.

To Sam: Hi Sam, can we swap Thursday for Friday? There is a family event, so it would help me a lot. Thanks! To Mr Lee: Dear Mr Lee, I was wondering whether I could move my session to Friday. I have a family event on Thursday, and I apologise for the short notice. Kind regards. To the manager: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding my Thursday booking. Would it be possible to move it to Friday? I have a family event. Thank you in advance.

feedback.es: Cada versión adapta el saludo, la forma de pedir y el cierre al lector, con la misma razón en las tres.

origin.text: Petición: cambiar tu sesión del jueves al viernes por un evento familiar. Escribe tres mensajes cortos: uno para Sam (compañero), otro para Mr Lee (profesor) y otro para el gerente del servicio (desconocido). Cada uno con su saludo, su petición suavizada y su cierre.

prompt.es: Elige el conector que encaja: la segunda frase es una consecuencia.

feedback.es: Therefore presenta la consecuencia de que el vuelo se retrasó; moreover suma información y however contrasta.

origin.text: My flight was delayed. ___ I cannot attend on Thursday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me preguntaba si podría cambiar mi reserva.»

feedback.es: Con I was wondering whether se usa could, no can, para suavizar la petición.

origin.text: I was wondering whether I ___ move my booking.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige a quién escribe la persona.

choices.text: A company, with very official phrases.
A teacher, in a polite neutral tone.

feedback.es: Dear Ms Brown y I was wondering whether… indican un lector con autoridad a quien se respeta, pero no una empresa anónima.

origin.audio: Dear Ms Brown, I was wondering whether I could hand in my essay on Monday instead. I would be very grateful.

prompt.es: Elige el cierre que encaja con un mensaje a un gerente.

feedback.es: Kind regards es el cierre formal adecuado para un desconocido o un servicio.

prompt.es: Completa: «Le pido disculpas por el poco aviso.»

feedback.es: Apologise es el verbo formal para pedir disculpas en un mensaje escrito.

prompt.es: Escribe en inglés el mensaje a un compañero.

answer.text: Hey Tom, could you lend me your notes from Thursday? Cheers!
accepted: Hey Tom, could you lend me your notes from Thursday? Cheers!
Hi Tom, can you lend me your notes from Thursday? Thanks!

feedback.es: Un compañero recibe saludo informal, una pregunta breve con could you y un cierre como Cheers.

origin.text: Pídele a Tom que te preste sus apuntes del jueves; tono informal.
